background_setting: A multi-lane divided highway during a heavy downpour under dark, overcast skies. The wet asphalt is nearly black and reflective, with sheets of standing water pooling between lanes that mirror the white dashed lane markings and the diffuse light of vehicle tail lights. Guardrails and faint roadside barriers blur along the edges. The horizon is lost in grey mist and rain, and the whole scene is dim, low-contrast, and saturated with moisture.

lighting.conditions: Dark overcast daylight, heavily diffused by storm clouds and rain
lighting.direction: Flat, ambient overhead light with no visible sun
lighting.shadows: Minimal, soft shadows; almost no hard shadows due to the diffuse overcast
lighting.illumination_effect: Low-contrast, gloomy illumination that flattens depth and emphasizes wet reflective surfaces and glowing tail lights

aesthetics.composition: First-person ego perspective centered on the open ego lane, with the truck and its spray offset to the right and lane markings converging toward the misty vanishing point ahead
aesthetics.color_scheme: Desaturated palette of dark greys, charcoal asphalt, muted whites of lane markings, and smeared red tail-light accents
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating dashed white lane markings and rhythmic streaks of rain across the camera

context: Autonomous or assisted driving demonstration of hazard recognition and speed reduction in poor weather

The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle detects the poor visibility and standing water and begins to slow markedly, letting the distant vehicle ahead pull further away. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle continues rolling at the reduced speed, maintaining a widened following distance while the truck's spray persists to the right. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
